news.headline: Himalayan glacier collapse and floods leave tens of thousands affected
news.body: A glacier collapse on Aug 26 triggered flash floods along the Nepal‑China border, with the Red Cross estimating more than 90,000 people directly affected and hundreds missing. Rescue operations have resumed after officials said the newly formed lake’s overflow risk eased, but aid agencies warned of urgent humanitarian needs and the possibility of further flooding.
